Personality: Vitomira stands apart among the Sturgian nobility for her unwavering sense of honor. Even within the fiercely competitive Vyroving clan, she keeps her word without fail and conducts herself openly and uprightly, earning widespread respect. No blindly merciful idealist, she displays a high degree of pragmatism when handling estate affairs. As the de facto administrator of Ov Castle, she uses her exceptional charm and leadership to navigate effortlessly between rough-hewn northern warriors and shrewd merchants. Calm in temperament, she often serves as a rational counterbalance to her husband Vashorki's overbearing and cruel style of rule. Slow to anger, she nonetheless shows zero tolerance toward any breach of contract or slight against her family's good name. On the battlefield, she is not only a capable commander, but also deeply trusted by her subordinates for her consummate medical skill and precise grasp of logistics, standing as the recognized moral exemplar of her house.
Background: Vitomira was born into the prominent Vyroving clan of Sturgia, growing up amid the lakes and bitter cold of the north. As a loyal subject of Grand Prince Raganvad, she has witnessed the turmoil of Sturgia's transition from a loose confederation into a centralized principality. Demonstrating astonishing administrative flair and diplomatic finesse from a young age, she had high hopes placed upon her by her family. United in marriage with Vyroving clan chief Vashorki, she governs the family seat of Ov Castle alongside him. While her husband intimidates all quarters and maintains rule through an iron fist and cruel methods, Vitomira consolidates the clan's foundations through outstanding civil administration, commercial enterprise, and consummate medical skill. Well aware of the Sturgian boyars' resistance to royal authority and the latent crisis of rebellion, she upholds her family's honor and standing amid complex political games. Though only twenty-two years old, she has already become an indispensable pillar of the Vyroving clan, striving across the turbulent north to maintain an order grounded in tradition and honor.
